description: Columnar drag-and-drop board with user-defined columns, count badges, and optional WIP limits

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to JSON data for columns and items. Fetched once per value; a new value replaces the board and aborts an older in-flight request

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Optional heading above the board; also names the board region

childAttributes.name: data-column-label
childAttributes.description: Display label for the column header

childAttributes.name: data-wip
childAttributes.description: Optional WIP limit — visual warning when exceeded

childAttributes.name: data-column-color
childAttributes.description: Color token for column tint (success, warning, error, info)

events.name: kanban-board:ready
events.description: Fired once after the first render. With src, fired once the JSON has loaded and rendered. Once per element: not re-fired by a later src change (watch items-changed with source 'src') or when the board is moved in the DOM

events.name: kanban-board:wip-exceeded
events.description: Fired when a drop takes a column over its WIP limit

events.name: kanban-board:items-changed
events.description: Fired after the items array changes: an .items assignment, or a .columns assignment that drops cards (source 'api'), a drag (source 'drag'), or each src load once its data has rendered (source 'src'). Filter on source to avoid feedback loops

events.name: kanban-board:upgraded
events.description: Fired (in a microtask) each time the board connects and upgrades; a safe signal for assigning .columns / .items from a framework
